edge_players.edge_sentence: Jones can exceed 71.5 rushing yards because Minnesota's concentrated recent rushing workload meets a NO defense allowing 5.27 yards per carry and repeated chunk runs.
edge_players.must_be_true: aaronjones carries >= 18 [because the pack records 60 carries over weeks 2–4]
edge_players.kills_it: IF NO builds an early multi-score lead and Minnesota abandons sustained rushing THEN aaronjones rushyds over 71.5 fails

edge_players.edge_sentence: Kamara can stay below 32.5 rushing yards because his recent rushing workload is limited and shared with Etienne, Miller and Shough, leaving little volume cushion if NO must chase.

data_check.notes: Reads were formed from workload, defensive matchup and conditional script before comparing lines. Jones's 85.7 recent rushing yards per game exceed 71.5; Kamara's 24.7 fall below 32.5. Those summaries support the hypotheses but are not projections or hit probabilities. Jones needs approximately 3.97 yards per carry at the proposed 18-carry workload to clear his line. Kamara could beat his under with only 10 carries at 3.3 yards per carry, making that leg particularly efficiency-sensitive. Listed -114 requires 53.27% to break even; -113 requires 53.05%. No model or simulation was run, and neither leg is established as positive expected value.

pre_mortem: Jones: It is Monday and the over lost because NO's season-to-date rushing allowance did not translate to this matchup, Minnesota fell behind, or Jones's workload was smaller than the three-game aggregate suggested. Missing line health and individual-game carry distributions are meaningful vulnerabilities. Kamara: The under lost because 32.5 is a low threshold, MIN's 4.15 yards allowed per carry is not prohibitive, and a modest efficiency rebound or one long run overcame limited volume. A NO lead could also expand his carries. These counter-cases keep both selections at lean rather than strong; neither workload condition guarantees the outcome.
slip_story: One conditional story: Minnesota sustains a Jones-led rushing attack while NO chases through its higher-volume receiving options, supporting Jones rushing over and Kamara rushing under together. Both are script-dependent and vulnerable to the NO-leads flip. Do not force a 3–4-leg main slip from only two supported candidates; no additional leg or joint probability is established, and no bet is placed.
